children: Bitdeer Technologies Group secured a 10-year deal for a 67MW AI data center in Malaysia, lifting secured AI Cloud capacity to ~273.5MW (~78% of a target up to 350MW by Q1 2028). A901 delivery is expected to start Q1 2027 and reach full 67MW in Q2 2027.

Context by AI Analyst

This extends Bitdeer’s push into AI data centers, advancing a multi-year scale-up with most of its target capacity now secured. For this to catalyze shares, investors will look for signed offtake contracts, financing clarity, and on-time energization in 2027.
